subject.title: fix(nostr): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: Which of the two overlapping Nostr sanitizer PRs should be retained as the single canonical implementation?
rationale: Both branches target the same user-visible delivery invariant, but the related branch is dirty while this one is mergeable and freshly rebased; choosing one avoids duplicate maintenance without requiring a new product direction.

options.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
options.body: Retain this mergeable, proof-backed branch and close the overlapping dirty implementation after confirming no unique behavior remains there.

options.title: Adopt the other PR instead
options.body: Only choose the overlapping branch if an owner identifies a concrete unique behavior or proof gap that this branch does not cover.
